Methods

The ÄKTA Pure chromatography run was executed using an automated protocol with a manual sample loading step followed by the programmed method phases.

Overview of Automated Workflow
  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The system was paused to allow manual filling of the sample loop as indicated by the workflow message "Manually fill sample loop".
    • Once the sample loop was filled, the run was resumed to start the automated ÄKTA protocol.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Protocol Execution
    • The programmed ÄKTA Pure method was started using the "Run Protocol" operation.
    • During the run, UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) signals were continuously monitored and recorded at the defined sampling interval.
    • The following time-based phases were included in the method (durations refer to column processing steps):
Run Parameters
Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated chromatography process.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Total time for column equilibration before loading.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during column equilibration.
Load / Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Time period for sample loading or injection onto the column.
Load / Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during sample loading or injection.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of post-load column wash to remove unbound material.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during column wash.
Elute Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total time of the elution gradient step.
Elute Gradient Start %B [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer B percentage of the elution gradient.
Elute Gradient End %B [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer B percentage of the elution gradient.
CIP Duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Total duration of the primary cleaning-in-place (CIP) step.
CIP 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP phase.
CIP 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP phase.
CIP 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP phase.
CIP 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP phase.
